title: Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
main_claim: There is a velocity-compactly-supported datum F_0 on T^3 x R^3 with finite mass, energy and entropy for which the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation has two different global renormalized entropy solutions. Both satisfy exact local conservation of mass, momentum and energy with initial traces, both lie in C([0,inf);L^1), and both have separately integrable gain and loss terms against every polynomial velocity weight on finite time intervals.
coverage: Read in full and checked: Secs 1-2 (definition and framework), Sec 4 (construction), Sec 5 (cold jets), Sec 6 (early selection and continuation), Sec 7 (global continuation), Sec 8 (compactness and local conservation), Sec 12 (separation), plus the gain-small-mass and hot-bound lemmas in Sec 3. Checks done: (1) Diophantine bound |m - sqrt2 k| >= c/(1+|k|+|m|), and tube disjointness up to L_s = s^{-1/2}: c'S^{1/2} beats 4S. (2) Barrier derivative D log m_i >= (1 + 7/8 |xi|^2/d^2)/L, by completing the square, and D|xi|^2 = -2U_z xi_3^2. (3) The choice eps_s = C L d/s makes U_i a supersolution. Remainder amplitude is d_0 s^{15/2}; nonmain factor is exp(-c s^{-15}); tube volume sums to O(s_0^{3/2}). (4) Entropy-to-L^1 Cauchy-Schwarz bound. (5) Frequency lemma: kappa does not depend on B, the entropy tolerance is chosen after B, and the two-ball argument holds. (6) Excess-mass flight-averaging bootstrap, with the order of choices eps -> rho, L -> eps_E, s_0 -> zeta; no circularity. (7) Gronwall constant B_* = (B0+(C4+C5)/kappa+1)exp(4C3/kappa) is fixed before B; retirement sum J_0 -> 0; bootstrap restarts correctly at jumps. (8) Envelope square: int_0^tau s^2/(t+s)^2 dt <= Cs. Also checked pair uniform integrability, the collision-moment bound, averaging-lemma hypotheses, the |v|^3 weight in the energy flux, and entropy lower semicontinuity. (9) Separation: scaling identity h_r/(m r) <= rho^{-1} f(rho t, rho x, v), Jacobian rho^{-5}, dormant-vanishing exponents (A > p+1, cold Gaussian s^{-31} exp(-c eps^2/(d_0^2 s^20))), diagonal argument and quantifiers. Skimmed only, taken on trust: Secs 9-11 (dilation limit, nonconcentration, branching finite horizon), which the paper says are adapted from the companion OpenAIPeriodic; I checked their interfaces and the normalization of the cap/dilation, and the (1+a)^4 < 3 growth-versus-volume heuristic. Lemmas 3.x on sheet and parameter kernel estimates were not rechecked.
sibling_notes: The family 363 board was empty when I started. Sections 9-11 rely on the companion 'Nonuniqueness-for-the-periodic-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-September-23-2026' (cited as OpenAIPeriodic). It has no review on the board, so a review of it would cover the part of this paper I took on trust. The new material here — global continuation via a bath plus small entropy giving a uniform collision frequency, finite jet lifetimes on an irrational axis, and weighted collision integrability — checked out.
